method.short_tasks: Same request hashes as 220 W. One warmup plus three trials per mode. Output includes reasoning. Chart image is warm; fresh text-prefix cache salts. Bounded prose caps thinking at 256 tokens.
method.coding: One tests-first generation per mode, raw and extracted submissions graded in isolation. With DSpark the generated source matches the 220 W passing output by SHA-256. With drafting off this generation had an unmatched closing parenthesis and failed to execute.
method.agentx: One serial pass of five fixed-output requests per cache condition and mode. Request hashes, lengths and cached-token counts cross-checked against the release replay.
method.guide: One cold, intact LongBench v2 user-guide question per mode, identical prompt hash. TTFT includes request overhead.
method.accuracy: Same 24 MMLU-Pro questions, seed, temperature, reasoning effort and output cap as the upstream comparison.
